title: Quarkonium-System: heavy-quarkonium spectroscopy with the Gaussian Expansion Method
description: Charmonium, bottomonium and B_c spectra from non-relativistic and relativized (Godfrey-Isgur) potential models, with and without a screened confining potential, solved with the Gaussian Expansion Method in C++ and fitted to the PDG 2026 masses, with a statistical analysis of the models. The release includes the logged output of every fit used in the accompanying paper.
